title: XGBoost Tutorial: Implementing Gradient Boosting for Classification Problems

cues.en: -: Hello, and welcome to this tutorial.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到這堂教學。

cues.en: So you learned a lot of stuff but it would be a shame to leave this course without having some introduction to one of the most popular algorithm in machinery
cues.zh: 已經學了很多，但如果沒有介紹機器學習最熱門的演算法之一，就離開課程，會很可惜，

cues.en: that is quite recently popular but still it is definitely a very powerful model.
cues.zh: 它近來變得熱門，而且確實是非常強大的模型。

cues.en: Especially if you work on large data sets, it will offer you very high performance while being fast to execute.
cues.zh: 尤其處理大型資料集，效能很好，執行也很快。

cues.en: And speaking of performance and execution speed, it is important to remind that XGBoost is the most powerful implementation of gradient boosting
cues.zh: 說到效能與速度，提醒一下，講者認為 XGBoost 是梯度提升法最強大的實作，

cues.en: in terms of model performance and execution speed.
cues.zh: 不論模型效能或執行速度。

cues.en: Therefore, it's very important for you to have it in your toolkit.
cues.zh: 因此工具箱裡一定要有。

cues.en: So let's implement XGBoost.
cues.zh: 開始實作 XGBoost。

cues.en: This is only going to be an introduction so we will make a simple implementation of XGBoost but you will have the code template on your computer and you'll be able to try it on your problems,
cues.zh: 這只是入門，會做簡單實作，但你會有程式碼範本，能試用在自己的問題，

cues.en: on your data sets.
cues.zh: 與自己的資料集。

cues.en: And you'll see that even with this simple implementation, it'll definitely give you some excellent performance.
cues.zh: 你會看到，即使簡單實作，也能帶來很好的效能。

cues.en: And so now what we're gonna do is take one of the business problem we dealt with in this course.
cues.zh: 現在取用這門課處理過的一個商業問題。

cues.en: This is going to be actually the problem that we solved in the deep learning section.
cues.zh: 就是深度學習章節解決的問題。

cues.en: Remember this is the churn modeling problem where we need to predict the customers of the bank that will leave the bank.
cues.zh: 記得，顧客流失建模，預測哪些銀行顧客會離開。

cues.en: So this was a classification problem where we classify the customers in two classes, those who will leave the bank and those who will not leave the bank.
cues.zh: 這是分類問題，分成兩類：會離開銀行、不會離開銀行。

cues.en: And so remember for this problem we obtained an accuracy of 86% but that took quite a while because we trained an artificial neural network with many epochs
cues.zh: 記得當時準確率 86%，但花了一些時間，因為人工神經網路要訓練很多週期，

cues.en: and therefore it took quite some time to execute.
cues.zh: 所以執行相當久。

cues.en: And so now in this section we're gonna do the same.
cues.zh: 現在這一節做相同問題。

cues.en: We are going to apply XGBoost on this churn modeling problem.
cues.zh: 將 XGBoost 套用到顧客流失建模。

cues.en: This data set contains if I remember 13 features but that's not a large data set.
cues.zh: 如果記得沒錯，資料集有 13 個特徵，但不算大型資料集。

cues.en: And what is important to highlight is that even if this was a large data set, a very large data set, well, XGBoost would be one of the best model
cues.zh: 要強調的是，即使資料集非常大，XGBoost 仍是最佳模型之一，

cues.en: in terms of performance that is to get a good accuracy and execution speed.
cues.zh: 就效能，也就是準確率，以及執行速度而言。

cues.en: So, for example, if you are working with a large data set, I strongly encourage you to test XGBoost.
cues.zh: 所以如果處理大型資料集，非常建議試試 XGBoost。

cues.en: All right, so what we're gonna do now is take the pre-processing phase.
cues.zh: 現在取出前處理階段。

cues.en: So that is only part one because part two is to implement the artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 只有第一部分，因為第二部分是人工神經網路。

cues.en: And so we just want to pre-process the data for this churn modeling problem associated to this churn modeling CSV file.
cues.zh: 只需要前處理 Churn_Modelling.csv 對應的顧客流失問題資料。

cues.en: But actually we're not going to take everything in this pre-processing phase.
cues.zh: 但不取用整個前處理階段。

cues.en: The reason is that for the artificial neural network while feature scaling was totally compulsory, no questions asked, feature scaling must be applied
cues.zh: 原因是人工神經網路一定需要特徵縮放，沒有疑問，特徵縮放對

cues.en: for deep learning.
cues.zh: 深度學習很重要。

cues.en: But the good news is that for XGBoost, well, since XGBoost is a great in boosting model with decision trees, while accordingly feature scaling is totally unnecessary.
cues.zh: 但好消息是，XGBoost 使用決策樹的梯度提升模型，因此這裡完全不需要特徵縮放。

cues.en: And that's one of the very good thing about XGBoost besides its high performance and its fast execution speed.
cues.zh: 除了高效能與執行快速，這也是它的好處之一。

cues.en: It's that you can keep the interpretation of your problem of your dataset and of the result you'll get after building the model.
cues.zh: 能保留問題、資料集，以及建立模型後結果的可解讀性。

cues.en: So we can understand now why XGBoost is so popular.
cues.zh: 所以可以理解為什麼 XGBoost 熱門。

cues.en: It's because it has these three qualities.
cues.zh: 因為具備這三項優點。

cues.en: First quality, high performance, second quality, fast execution speed, and third quality, you can keep all the interpretation of your problem and your model.
cues.zh: 第一，高效能；第二，執行快；第三，保留問題與模型的可解讀性。

cues.en: So definitely a model to have in your toolkit.
cues.zh: 工具箱一定要有。

cues.en: All right, so feature scaling is unnecessary here and therefore we will take everything from here up to the top, like this,
cues.zh: 特徵縮放不需要，所以從這裡選到最上方，

cues.en: copy and we'll paste that in our XGBoost file.
cues.zh: 複製，再貼到 XGBoost 檔案。

cues.en: Here we go, and now we can implement XGBoost.
cues.zh: 好了，現在可以實作。

cues.en: So first, let's introduce new section fitting XGBoost to the training set.
cues.zh: 先新增區段，Fitting XGBoost to the Training Set。

cues.en: Alright, and first let's install XGBoost.
cues.zh: 首先安裝 XGBoost。

cues.en: So as usual, there is a package, it's the XGBoost package that will allow us to implement XGBoost very efficiently.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，有 xgboost 套件，可以有效率地實作。

cues.en: So let's type here as usual, install.packages.
cues.zh: 輸入 install.packages。

cues.en: And inside the name of the XGBoost package which is simply XGBoost like this.
cues.zh: 裡面放套件名，就是 xgboost。

cues.en: Then you select this line and press Command and Control plus Enter to execute.
cues.zh: 選取這行，按 Command 或 Control 加 Enter 執行。

cues.en: And that's installing the XGBoost package.
cues.zh: 開始安裝 xgboost。

cues.en: All right, we can see it's processing and here we go.
cues.zh: 可以看到正在處理，好了。

cues.en: So downloaded binary packages are in this package folder.
cues.zh: 下載的二進位套件放在這個套件資料夾。

cues.en: All good, XGBoost is installed.
cues.zh: 沒問題，xgboost 已安裝。

cues.en: So let's put that section and comment, there.
cues.zh: 把這行改成註解。

cues.en: And now let's import the XGBoost package because indeed we installed it.
cues.zh: 現在載入 xgboost，因為已經安裝了。

cues.en: But if we go down to the bottom, XGBoost is installed but not imported and we want to make it automatic.
cues.zh: 往下看，套件已安裝但沒載入，希望讓載入自動化。

cues.en: So as usual, we use the command library and inside XGBoost and that will import the package.
cues.zh: 使用 library，括號裡填 xgboost，就能載入。

cues.en: All right, and now let's implement XGBoost.
cues.zh: 現在實作 XGBoost。

cues.en: And actually this is going to take one line because we're just gonna make the classifier, the XGBoost classifier itself.
cues.zh: 其實只要一行，就能建立 XGBoost 分類器本身。

cues.en: And so basically we just need to create a new variable that we call as usual classifier and then equals and then we use the XGBoost function
cues.zh: 建立新變數，照慣例叫 classifier，等於，再使用 xgboost 函式，

cues.en: from this XGBoost package.
cues.zh: 來自 xgboost 套件。

cues.en: So XGBoost and parenthesis, and let's click here, press F1, and get some information about this XGBoost function.
cues.zh: 輸入 xgboost、括號，點這裡按 F1，取得函式資訊。

cues.en: So the information we are interested in are the arguments and what arguments do we need here?
cues.zh: 要看的資訊是參數，需要哪些？

cues.en: Okay, so first we see that we have this params parameter which is actually a list of parameters.
cues.zh: 首先看到 params，實際上是參數串列。

cues.en: And these parameters are all the parameters that you can see here.
cues.zh: 裡面包括這裡顯示的全部參數。

cues.en: For example, the exec parameter that controls the learning rate, the gamma parameter, which is the minimum loss reduction.
cues.zh: 例如控制學習率的 eta，以及代表最小損失降低量的 gamma。

cues.en: Well, you have a a lot of these parameters but this tutorial is just an introduction of XGBoost.
cues.zh: 有很多參數，但這堂只是 XGBoost 入門。

cues.en: So we will not do some tuning on our XGBoost model in this course, but I'm sure in some future courses I will make some more complex implementations of XGBoost
cues.zh: 所以本課程不對 XGBoost 調參，但未來課程一定會做更複雜的實作，

cues.en: on some more complex problems.
cues.zh: 處理更複雜的問題。

cues.en: But in this course, it's just to end with a simple introduction of XGBoost so that you can at least have some knowledge about it and have it in your toolkit.
cues.zh: 這裡只是以簡單入門收尾，至少讓你認識它，並放進工具箱。

cues.en: So let's not focus on this now and let's move on to the compulsory parameters that are, of course, the first one is data.
cues.zh: 先不深入參數，進入必要參數，第一個當然是 data。

cues.en: So data is, of course, your training set.
cues.zh: data 就是訓練集。

cues.en: The data sets on which you want to train your XGBoost model.
cues.zh: 也就是要訓練 XGBoost 的資料集。

cues.en: And so let's input that right now.
cues.zh: 現在輸入。

cues.en: So first argument, data equals then training set.
cues.zh: 第一個參數，data = training_set。

cues.en: Here we go, and actually here we only need the features in the training set.
cues.zh: 不過這裡只需要訓練集的特徵。

cues.en: So we will remove the dependent variable from this training set because this training set contains both the features and the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 要移除依變數，因為 training_set 同時包含特徵與依變數。

cues.en: But what this data parameter expects is only the features.
cues.zh: data 預期的只有特徵。

cues.en: So here we add some brackets and we remove the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 加上中括號，移除依變數。

cues.en: And what is this index?
cues.zh: 索引是多少？

cues.en: Well, to do this, we need to import the data set.
cues.zh: 要知道，得先匯入資料集。

cues.en: But first, before importing the data set, let's quickly set the right folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 但匯入前，快速將正確資料夾設為工作目錄。

cues.en: So right now we are in part 10.
cues.zh: 目前在 Part 10。

cues.en: Then section 49 XGBoost, that's the right folder, make sure that you have the churn modeling CSV file, and then click on set as working directory here.
cues.zh: 再進 Section 49 XGBoost，確認有 Churn_Modelling.csv，按 Set As Working Directory。

cues.en: And here we go, now we can import the dataset.
cues.zh: 好了，現在可以匯入資料集。

cues.en: So let's import it, and that's the dataset.
cues.zh: 匯入，這就是資料。

cues.en: But remember, in this dataset we don't take all the independent variables 'cause we're not interested in row number, customer ID and surname.
cues.zh: 記得不使用全部自變數，因為不需要 RowNumber、CustomerId、Surname。

cues.en: We know that these three variables have no impact on the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 我們認為這三個變數不影響依變數。

cues.en: So we remove them and that's what we do in this line.
cues.zh: 所以移除，就在這一行。

cues.en: Data set equals data set 4 14.
cues.zh: dataset = dataset[4:14]。

cues.en: That means that we take all the variables from the fourth variable of data set that is credit score up to the last variable exited, the dependent variable,
cues.zh: 也就是取第四個變數 CreditScore，一直到最後一個 Exited，這是依變數，

cues.en: that's the dependent variable and so let's select this line and execute.
cues.zh: 選取這行並執行。

cues.en: And now if we look at our data set, well, this contains all the relevant features and the dependent variable exited.
cues.zh: 再看資料集，現在包含所有相關特徵與依變數 Exited。

cues.en: And so the challenge is with all these independent variables here, we want to predict if the customer will leave or stay in the bank.
cues.zh: 挑戰是用所有自變數，預測顧客會離開還是留在銀行。

cues.en: And so that's the data set we consider to train the model and test its performance and therefore, the index of the dependent variable we have to remove now
cues.zh: 這是訓練與測試模型使用的資料集，所以現在要從 xgboost 的 data 參數移除的

cues.en: in the XGBoost function for the data parameter is the last index here of the exited column.
cues.zh: 依變數索引，就是最後一欄 Exited 的索引。

cues.en: And since we have 11 variables, well, that index is 11.
cues.zh: 共有 11 個變數，所以索引為 11。

cues.en: So let's go back to XGBoost and let's go back to our function.
cues.zh: 回到 XGBoost，回到函式。

cues.en: And therefore here we have to input minus 11.
cues.zh: 因此這裡輸入 -11。

cues.en: All right, so we have our whole training set but without the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 得到整個訓練集，但不含依變數。

cues.en: So that's perfect, that's exactly what we want.
cues.zh: 正是我們需要的。

cues.en: So now let's go back to help to see if we need some more info about this first parameter.
cues.zh: 再回到說明，看看第一個參數是否還有其他資訊。

cues.en: Well, indeed there is some very important information that we need to consider here.
cues.zh: 確實，有非常重要的資訊必須考慮。

cues.en: It's that this input data set needs to be an xgb.DMatrix.
cues.zh: 輸入資料需要是 xgb.DMatrix。

cues.en: So that's basically a type of matrix but we can also see that in addition data, the data parameter, also accepts matrix.
cues.zh: 基本上是一種矩陣，但也可以看到，data 同時接受一般矩陣。

cues.en: But this is not a matrix, this is a data frame.
cues.zh: 目前不是矩陣，而是資料框。

cues.en: So this won't work if we input the features this way.
cues.zh: 這樣直接輸入特徵不會成功。

cues.en: So we can either convert this into an xgb.DMatrix or a simple matrix.
cues.zh: 可以轉成 xgb.DMatrix，或一般矩陣。

cues.en: So let's take the simplest solution.
cues.zh: 採用最簡單做法。

cues.en: Let's convert this data frame of features into a matrix.
cues.zh: 將特徵資料框轉成矩陣。

cues.en: And you know how to do this.
cues.zh: 你知道怎麼做。

cues.en: We just need to use the as dot matrix function and put inside some parenthesis, because it's a function, this data frame of features.
cues.zh: 使用 as.matrix，括號內放入這個特徵資料框。

cues.en: Here we go, and now this becomes a matrix and that's exactly what we need.
cues.zh: 好了，現在變成矩陣，正是需要的。

cues.en: All right, perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Then next argument.
cues.zh: 下一個參數。

cues.en: So here again, you have a lot of other arguments but these are not compulsory so we won't focus on them now.
cues.zh: 還有許多其他參數，但不是必要，暫時不深入。

cues.en: But the next compulsory argument is this label argument because indeed here we input the matrix of features.
cues.zh: 下一個必要參數是 label，因為這裡只傳入特徵矩陣。

cues.en: But of course, to train a classification model we need not only the matrix of features but also the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 訓練分類模型，當然不只要特徵矩陣，也需要依變數。

cues.en: And that's what we put in this label parameter.
cues.zh: 就是放在 label 參數。

cues.en: And so as you might expect, since we input the features into a matrix, well, we need to input this label parameter as a vector.
cues.zh: 既然特徵以矩陣輸入，label 就要以向量輸入。

cues.en: And to get our dependent variable as a vector, we need to input label equals our training set, then dollar and then we take the name of our dependent viable
cues.zh: 取得依變數向量，輸入 label = training_set，再加 $，取出依變數名稱，

cues.en: which is exited, and this will give us a vector.
cues.zh: 就是 Exited，這會得到向量。

cues.en: So training set dollar exited is the dependent viable but given as a vector.
cues.zh: training_set$Exited 就是以向量提供的依變數。

cues.en: So that's exactly what we need because indeed as you can see, label is expected to be a vector, the vector of response values.
cues.zh: 正是所需，因為說明中 label 預期是向量，也就是回應值向量。

cues.en: The response values are, of course, the values of the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 回應值當然就是依變數的值。

cues.en: All right, now, next argument.
cues.zh: 下一個參數。

cues.en: What is the next argument?
cues.zh: 是什麼？

cues.en: Well, there is a third compulsory argument that we need to input here and that is actually above but I wanted to put the label after the matrix of features
cues.zh: 還有第三個必要參數，其實列在上方，但我想把 label 放在特徵矩陣後面，

cues.en: that made kind of sense.
cues.zh: 這樣比較合理。

cues.en: And now there is a third argument that we need to input which is the N rounds argument.
cues.zh: 第三個要輸入的參數是 nrounds。

cues.en: And the N rounds argument is the maximum number of iterations.
cues.zh: nrounds 是最大迭代次數。

cues.en: So since we're not working on a too complex problem, well, a maximum number of 10 iterations will be sufficient.
cues.zh: 問題沒有太複雜，所以最多 10 次迭代就足夠。

cues.en: So we will input here N rounds equals 10 and XGBoost will be trained in maximum 10 iterations.
cues.zh: 輸入 nrounds = 10，最多訓練 10 次迭代。

cues.en: Perfect, and now actually this line of code is ready to be executed to train the XGBoost classifier.
cues.zh: 很好，現在這行可以執行，訓練 XGBoost 分類器。

cues.en: So even if XGBoost is a very advanced machine learning problem, well, thanks to this extra boost package, you just need this single simple line of code
cues.zh: 即使 XGBoost 是很進階的機器學習模型，有了 xgboost 套件，只需這一行簡單程式，

cues.en: to implement it very efficiently.
cues.zh: 就能有效率地實作。

cues.en: All right, we're not going to execute this line now because first we need to run the data pre-processing phase and then I would like to add some code sections to evaluate our XGBoost model performance.
cues.zh: 現在先不執行，因為要先前處理資料，也想加入評估 XGBoost 效能的區段。

cues.en: So we are going to execute the whole thing in the end but for now, let's add the last sections to evaluate the XGBoost performance.
cues.zh: 最後再一起執行，現在先加入最後的效能評估部分。

cues.en: And, of course, we are gonna take our k-fold cross validation technique to evaluate it.
cues.zh: 當然使用 k 折交叉驗證。

cues.en: And therefore here I'm going to take the k-fold cross validation section which is right here and we're going to use it on our XGBoost model.
cues.zh: 取用這裡的交叉驗證區段，套用到 XGBoost。

cues.en: So here I just need to copy this section, go back to my XGBoost model and paste it here.
cues.zh: 複製，回到 XGBoost，貼在這裡。

cues.en: And be careful inside of it, we need to change the classifier because right here that's a kernel SVM classifier.
cues.zh: 注意，裡面要換分類器，因為這裡原本是核 SVM。

cues.en: And so basically we just need to replace this kernel SVM classifier by our XGBoost classifier.
cues.zh: 基本上，把核 SVM 分類器換成 XGBoost。

cues.en: So I'm just copying that here and go back to my k-fold cross validation section and paste the code to train the XGBoost classifier on the training set right here.
cues.zh: 複製這段，回到交叉驗證區段，將訓練 XGBoost 的程式貼在這裡。

cues.en: All right, and then we need to add another line of code inside a section.
cues.zh: 接著區段裡還需要多加一行。

cues.en: It's related to the fact that this XGBoost model will return the predictions as probabilities.
cues.zh: 因為這個 XGBoost 模型會以機率回傳預測。

cues.en: You know, it'll return the probability of class one and therefore you know this trick to convert the probabilities into the real predictions, zero or one.
cues.zh: 會回傳第 1 類的機率，你知道把機率轉成 0 或 1 的技巧。
